reason: The quote is verbatim: ArenaResetService.java:196-201 gates only STARTING/RUNNING/WAVE_INTERMISSION (GAME_IN_PROGRESS) and ENDING (RESET_IN_PROGRESS), so VICTORY/DEFEAT fall through to Gate.OK at :202, and the Gate javadoc at :82-86 admits the omission. The proposed refutation ('state stays RUNNING during settlement, so canReset already blocks') is wrong because it conflates two separate state machines: GameManager.haltGame() (:701-715) deliberately leaves *GameManager.state* RUNNING (the S06-F4 premise), but ArenaInstance.beginEndSequence() sets the *ArenaInstance* field at ArenaInstance.java:814 ('state = victory ? GameState.VICTORY : GameState.DEFEAT;'), and canReset reads exactly that field through live.getState() -> ArenaInstance.getState() (ArenaInstance.java:228-231, field at :75), not gameManager.getState(). During the default 20 s defeat-countdown (GameConfig.java:52, game-settings.yml:33) the arena therefore sits in VICTORY/DEFEAT with players still inside (NpcManager.java:139-148, ArenaAdminService.java:372 both state this explicitly), and finishSession() only removes them at countdown expiry (:891-899). So the reset is reachable: ArenaManageGUI's TNT item at :285-290 is always clickable, confirmReset() (:750-772) re-runs canReset() and gets OK, then proceed() step 4 calls multi.disableArena() (:286), whose own gate (MultiArenaManager.java:450-453) rejects only the same three in-play states, so stopGame() runs, kicks every player (:768-771) and schedules the rollback (:777). What keeps this out of medium is impact, not reachability: the match is already decided and broadcastSessionStats()/game-victory|game-defeat fire at t=0 (:816-819), so only the cosmetic 'returning in N seconds' countdown and the sidebar are cut, no stats are lost; the action is admin-initiated, double-confirmed through a RESET_CONFIRM page that already prints 'Will kick N player(s) currently inside' (ArenaManageGUI.java:718-720, messages.yml:1086) and warns that core/spawns/nodes/map will be wiped, and the end state (arena disabled and undeployed) is exactly what 'reset' is documented to produce. It remains a genuine gate inconsistency worth fixing (NpcManager.isGameInProgress and ArenaAdminService.updateGameParams both treat VICTORY/DEFEAT as in-progress), which is why it is downgraded rather than revoked, but the realistic damage is an early exit from a 20 s summary screen the admin explicitly asked to interrupt.
